>That is where there is a list from WOTC of Jyhad cards... How rare are

(Apologies if I have mis-interpreted what you want, but I do not fully
understand the first sentence, since it seems to refer to something
which isn't there.)

Vampire cards (i.e. cards with a Vampire on them) are Vampire rarity,
which is different from Common, Uncommon or Rare.

If you want a full list of rarities, check:

http://www.wizards.com/vtes/rules.asp

Which has a full list of card sets.
